reasoning: Opta (45.7%) and the market (about 45-46%) agree Everton are clear favourites. Both sides are missing their first-choice striker (Mateta, Igor Jesus), Forest have scored only 4 in 5, and Palace drew 0-0 at Leeds last time out.
